description: Recall structurally compatible graph strategies using observed yield and native per-step application receipts; stale contexts invalidate and failed candidates fall back to bounded search.

microtheory.name: strategy_library
microtheory.description: Retain observed strategy yields and recall compatible candidates without treating expected yield as proof.

rules.name: sl_invalidate_strategy_distribution_change
rules.comment: Retire a strategy yield record when its owning process distribution/model epoch changes.

rules.name: sl_record_observed_solved_strategy
rules.comment: Create a reusable strategy entry only from a genuinely solved graph task and its actual process trace; the initial yield prior is one observed success, never an expected outcome.

rules.name: sl_request_funded_strategy_recall
rules.comment: Request one shared ThinkingBudget debit before weighting or applying any compatible strategy; bind it to this task and its source/model epoch.

rules.name: sl_start_soft_weighted_compatible_recall
rules.comment: Recall among structurally compatible strategies using native SoftWeights over observed yield, gated by context and all source/model/frame/probe epochs; leave cold-start tasks to the bounded solver.

rules.name: sl_apply_and_reverify_strategy_step
rules.comment: Apply one stored process through native ProcessApply, write an application receipt, and check progress against the current task; strategy recall never substitutes expected yield for verification.

rules.name: sl_fail_nonapplicable_recall_step
rules.comment: Reject a recalled step when native application is unknown or makes no state change, so the bounded solver can resume instead of stalling.

rules.name: sl_record_observed_success
rules.comment: Update yield only from a terminal observed strategy-recall outcome.

rules.name: sl_record_observed_failure
rules.comment: Update yield only from a terminal observed strategy-recall outcome.

rules.name: sl_fallback_to_bounded_solver_after_bad_recall
rules.comment: A failed or inapplicable recalled sequence is recorded as a rejected candidate, then yields the task to the existing bounded solver.

rules.name: sl_record_cold_start_fallback
rules.comment: When no current structurally compatible observed strategy exists, preserve cold start and let the bounded existing solver proceed.

rules.name: sl_fallback_after_recall_funding_denial
rules.comment: If the shared budget denies or expires the recall request, record the denial and continue through the bounded solver without retrying or bypassing the budget.

rules.name: sl_fallback_when_shared_budget_disabled
rules.comment: Do not perform strategy weighting without an enabled shared budget; record the reason and yield to the bounded solver.
